queries: select date_trunc('week',date) w, customer_segment, count(*) n, sum(quantity*unit_price) rev from sale where date>='2025-03-17' group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select date_trunc('week',date) w, count(*) n, sum((reason='zpoždění zásilky')::int) late_r, sum((reason='vadné zboží')::int) defect, sum((reason='nevyhovující velikost')::int) size_r, sum((reason='změna názoru')::int) mind from return_request group by 1 order by 1
select date_trunc('week',date) w, avg(value) s, sum((value=0)::int) zero from stock_snapshot group by 1 order by 1
select p.supplier_id, date_trunc('month',s.date) m, count(*) n, count(distinct s.product_id) prods from sale s join product p on p.id=s.product_id group by 1,2 order by 1,2
